related.title: LTE MIMO：層數變化下的淨資料預算
related.titleEn: LTE MIMO: useful-data budget across layer changes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 1344 information bit/interval 與 1176 information bit/interval，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 1344 information bit/interval and 1176 information bit/interval, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋1800 bit/interval與1000 bit/interval，建立lte_layers.csv、CSI年齡表、層別交付帳本，並完成以下驗收：1500位元目標需第二層有效率至少0.5；若CSI過期須重驗，不可只強制rank2。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 1800 bit/interval and 1000 bit/interval; create lte_layers.csv, CSI-age table and per-layer delivery ledger; apply this acceptance decision: A1500-bit target needs second-layer availability at least0.5; stale CSI requires revalidation rather than forcing rank2.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 每個資源格需分開資料、參考與控制元素；可用RE乘每RE編碼後資訊位元只估名義容量。 展開基準式 10*12*14*0.8*2*0.5；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以逐PRB遮罩計數RE再乘Qm與碼率；確保保留元素未再次算入資料區。 將兩條推導一起存入 lte_re_mask.csv、TBS邊界註記、保留RE清單。
從原理 固定每層效率時，名義位元數與可解碼層數成比例；Rank Indicator是通道適配資訊，不是保證吞吐。 展開基準式 1000+1000*0.8；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐層列新位元及失敗位元，不用總天線數替代成功層數；驗相同總功率假設。 將兩條推導一起存入 lte_layers.csv、CSI年齡表、層別交付帳本。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Separate data, reference and control elements; usable RE times information bits per RE gives only nominal capacity., expand baseline expression 10*12*14*0.8*2*0.5; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Count RE from a per-PRB mask before multiplying Qm and code rate; reserved elements must not be counted twice. Save both derivations with lte_re_mask.csv, TBS limitations and reserved-RE list.

Starting from At fixed per-layer efficiency nominal bits scale with decodable layers; rank indication is adaptation information, not a throughput guarantee., expand baseline expression 1000+1000*0.8; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Tabulate new and failed bits per layer; antenna count is not successful layer count and total-power assumptions must agree. Save both derivations with lte_layers.csv, CSI-age table and per-layer delivery ledger.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 5G NR LDPC：資訊、校驗與有效碼率
related.titleEn: 5G NR LDPC: information, checks and effective code rate
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 1344 information bit/interval 與 1176 information bit/interval，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 1344 information bit/interval and 1176 information bit/interval, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋0.48828125 information/code bit與0.651041666667 information/code bit，建立ldpc_bit_ledger.csv、率匹配索引測例、資訊/CRC分欄，並完成以下驗收：教學上限資訊碼率0.6時第二配置不接受；完整NR相容性仍需規範基圖、提升與率匹配。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 0.48828125 information/code bit and 0.651041666667 information/code bit; create ldpc_bit_ledger.csv, rate-matching index fixtures and information/CRC columns; apply this acceptance decision: The second case fails a teaching0.6 information-rate cap; NR conformance still requires specified base graphs, lifting and rate matching.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 每個資源格需分開資料、參考與控制元素；可用RE乘每RE編碼後資訊位元只估名義容量。 展開基準式 10*12*14*0.8*2*0.5；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以逐PRB遮罩計數RE再乘Qm與碼率；確保保留元素未再次算入資料區。 將兩條推導一起存入 lte_re_mask.csv、TBS邊界註記、保留RE清單。

從原理 有效碼率應用資訊位元除以實際傳送編碼位元；CRC、填充與率匹配需分別記帳，不能把所有校驗當有效資料。 展開基準式 1000/2048；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：分別列資訊碼率1000/E與含CRC比率1024/E；碼率增加並未增加原始1000 bit。 將兩條推導一起存入 ldpc_bit_ledger.csv、率匹配索引測例、資訊/CRC分欄。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Separate data, reference and control elements; usable RE times information bits per RE gives only nominal capacity., expand baseline expression 10*12*14*0.8*2*0.5; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Count RE from a per-PRB mask before multiplying Qm and code rate; reserved elements must not be counted twice. Save both derivations with lte_re_mask.csv, TBS limitations and reserved-RE list.

Starting from Effective code rate uses information bits divided by transmitted coded bits; CRC, filler and rate matching require separate accounting., expand baseline expression 1000/2048; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: List1000/E separately from CRC-inclusive1024/E; a higher rate does not create more than1000 information bits. Save both derivations with ldpc_bit_ledger.csv, rate-matching index fixtures and information/CRC columns.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
